title: Very different sticks.
text: Very different sticks.. 1st of all I love The Wood storage box That it comes in. You can even smell the wood. I love how you just store the sticks right in the box and then flip over the lid and there's a hole that you can put the stick in and burn it All I want you know. The only thing I didn't realize was The sticks Do not have a wood center And it makes it very fragile.As you can see in the picture how skinny they are But don't let that fool you because that smell It's so good and so strong from that little skinny stick. The scent that I got is dragon sandalwood and they are all natural. Love this!!
